specializations.cost: 1D of beginning skill dice buys three specializations
specializations.note: A specialization is rolled only when its specific item or knowledge applies; otherwise the base skill (or attribute) is rolled.

advanced_skills.requirement: Have the prerequisite skills at the listed level; beginning dice go into prerequisites first.
advanced_skills.prerequisite_roll_bonus: When rolling a prerequisite skill, add the advanced skill's dice to the roll.
advanced_skills.unused_on_template: Cross off if no beginning dice are placed.

new_template.attribute_limits: Each attribute must be between the species minimum and maximum die codes.
new_template.pips: A die can be split into three pips; +3 becomes the next full die (2D, 2D+1, 2D+2, 3D...).
new_template.force_skill_cost: 1D of attribute dice per 1D in control, sense or alter; gamemaster permission required; attributes may not drop below species minimum.

advancement.earning: Character Points are awarded after each adventure and spent between adventures.

skill.cost_per_pip: the number before the 'D' in the current die code (3D+2 -> 4D counts as one pip, cost 3)
skill.limit: One pip per skill between adventures; several different skills allowed.

specialization.cost_per_pip: half the number before the 'D', rounded up
specialization.separate_from_base: Improving the skill does not improve its specializations, and vice versa.

new_skill_or_specialization.cost: enough Character Points to reach one pip above the attribute (attribute 3D -> 3 points)

attribute.side_effect: All skills under the attribute (except advanced skills) also gain one pip.
attribute.ceiling_check: After training, the player rolls the new attribute code; the gamemaster rolls the species maximum for that attribute. Player roll <= gamemaster roll: attribute increases. Otherwise it does not and half the Character Points are returned.

become_force_sensitive.effect: Gain one Force Point immediately; must follow Force-sensitive guidelines; cannot be undone. Gamemaster may reduce the price for characters who closely followed the Jedi code.

training_time.applies_when: The skill or specialization was not used in the last adventure. If it was used, no training time. Attributes, Move and advanced skills always require training.

attribute_and_move.shorten: 1 additional Character Point per day cut

training_time.shorten_skill: 1 additional Character Point per day cut; minimum 1 day
rules: Skill does not improve until training is complete.
Only one skill can be trained at a time and not while off adventuring.
training_time.teacher_requirement: The teacher's skill (or the specific specialization) must be at least the value the student will reach.
